fields.title: Nile Cotton Baby Blanket
fields.description: Soft baby blanket made from premium Egyptian Nile cotton. Gentle on delicate skin and breathable for year-round comfort.

fields.title: Handmade Palm Cradle
fields.description: Traditional baby cradle woven from Egyptian palm leaves. Eco-friendly, lightweight, and perfect for safe baby naps.

fields.title: Siwa Cotton Baby Clothes Set
fields.description: Set of baby clothes made with organic cotton from Siwa. Includes bodysuit, hat, and mittens—soft and hypoallergenic.

fields.title: Luxor Baby Swaddle
fields.description: Handwoven cotton swaddle from Luxor. Lightweight, breathable, and ideal for keeping babies cozy and calm.

fields.title: Hand-Carved Wooden Baby Rattle
fields.description: Traditional Egyptian wooden rattle handcrafted by artisans. Safe, natural, and fun for babies to play with.

fields.title: Giza Cotton Baby Bibs (Pack of 3)
fields.description: Set of 3 bibs made from soft Giza cotton. Easy to wash, gentle on the skin, and perfect for messy meals.

fields.title: Aswan Baby Booties
fields.description: Hand-knitted baby booties from Aswan cotton yarn. Soft, breathable, and keeps tiny feet warm and comfy.

fields.title: Egyptian Cotton Baby Towel
fields.description: Ultra-soft towel made from 100% Egyptian cotton. Highly absorbent and perfect for wrapping your baby after a bath.

fields.title: Handwoven Palm Baby Basket
fields.description: Eco-friendly palm basket designed for carrying baby essentials. Lightweight, sturdy, and inspired by Egyptian craft traditions.

fields.title: Cairo Baby Pillow
fields.description: Small ergonomic pillow crafted with Egyptian cotton filling. Supports baby’s head and neck while ensuring maximum comfort.
